title: Node peer removal bypasses live-state and cleanup invariants
description: Node.remove_peer() (python/src/lichen/node.py lines 548-550) blindly deletes peer_db while add_peer eviction deliberately protects LinkLayer TOFU pins, announce pins, active fragmentation, RX-channel state, and live routes. Removing an active peer can strand fragment sessions, channel entries, gradients/DODAG references, and LinkLayer trust while making signature lookup fail. Define a coherent remove/forget operation that either refuses live peers or retires all dependent state through public layer APIs; also prevent direct peer_db mutation from bypassing canonicality/capacity. Add tests for pinned, routing-live, and active-fragment peers.
